# Eidoncore

> Eidoncore is the unified, AI-native agency management platform and white-label client portal built for modern digital agencies, creative studios, software dev shops, and consulting practices.

Eidoncore eliminates agency tool fragmentation by combining client portals, project milestone management, Kanban task boards, recurring retainer billing, CRM timelines, interactive proposals with e-signatures, intake forms, digital product sales, and native AI workspace agent orchestration into a single high-performance operating system.

## Core Capabilities & Feature Modules

- [AI Workspace](https://eidoncore.com/ai-workspace/): Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration connecting Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and custom AI agents with 111+ tool calls for autonomous agency operations.
- [Projects](https://eidoncore.com/projects/): Agency project management featuring real-time budget burndowns, milestone tracking, health scoring telemetry, and automated billable hours calculation.
- [Tasks](https://eidoncore.com/tasks/): Fluid Kanban task boards, subtask checklists, priority matrices, dense list views, and integrated live timer tracking.
- [CRM & Clients](https://eidoncore.com/crm/): Account health score tracking, visual deal sales funnels, unified communication timelines, and client lifetime value analytics.
- [Invoicing](https://eidoncore.com/invoicing/): Recurring monthly retainer billing, milestone disbursements, credit notes, refunds, and direct Stripe Connect payment processing.
- [Offerings & Services](https://eidoncore.com/services/): Productized service catalog allowing agency clients to browse standardized packages and purchase online with one-click checkout.
- [Proposals](https://eidoncore.com/proposals/): Interactive agency proposals with custom line-item toggles, scope add-on selectors, and legally binding digital e-signatures.
- [Client Portal](https://eidoncore.com/portal/): 100% white-label client portal hosted on custom agency domains (e.g., portal.youragency.com) with automated SSL, deliverable approvals, and ticket tracking.
- [Automations](https://eidoncore.com/automations/): Visual rule builder executing trigger-and-action workflows across project milestones, invoice payments, ticket alerts, and client notifications.
- [Messaging & Chat](https://eidoncore.com/messaging/): Real-time client channels, direct messaging, internal team threads, and asset sharing without lost Slack or WhatsApp history.
- [Reports & Intelligence](https://eidoncore.com/reports/): Agency financial analytics, billable team utilization, revenue concentration, and on-time deliverable scoring.
- [Notifications](https://eidoncore.com/notifications/): Multi-channel notification center spanning in-app alerts, desktop banners, and email activity digests.
- [Security & Compliance](https://eidoncore.com/security/): AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, row-level tenant database isolation, and role-based access control.
- [Team Management](https://eidoncore.com/team/): Team directory, hourly billing rates, contractor permissions, workload capacity tracking, and member onboarding.
- [File Management](https://eidoncore.com/files/): Secure agency asset storage with client download tracking, password-protected expiring share links, and folder organization.
- [Intake Forms](https://eidoncore.com/intake-forms/): Multi-step lead capture forms with conditional branching logic, file uploads, and auto-conversion into active CRM deals and task boards.
- [White-Label & Domains](https://eidoncore.com/white-label/): Custom CNAME mapping, agency logo, custom color palette, bespoke favicon, and custom SMTP email routing.
- [Digital Products](https://eidoncore.com/digital-products/): Storefront to sell Figma kits, code boilerplates, and design assets with zero platform fee and instant secure downloads.
- [Dashboard](https://eidoncore.com/dashboard/): Executive daily command center showing active projects, overdue deliverables, monthly revenue run-rate, and recent client activity.
- [Integrations](https://eidoncore.com/integrations/): Native integrations with Stripe, Slack, Zapier, Webhooks, Google Workspace, and GitHub.
- [Support Tickets](https://eidoncore.com/tickets/): Client support ticketing system with SLA response timers, priority queues, and internal notes.

## Agency Use Cases

- [Design Studios](https://eidoncore.com/use-cases/design-studios/): Creative deliverable sharing, visual feedback approvals, revision round limits, and asset gallery delivery.
- [Development Agencies](https://eidoncore.com/use-cases/development-agencies/): Sprint management, bug issue ticketing, milestone release invoicing, and GitHub/MCP webhook syncing.
- [Marketing Agencies](https://eidoncore.com/use-cases/marketing-agencies/): Retainer budget burndown tracking, campaign deliverable schedules, and transparent client reporting.
- [Consulting Firms](https://eidoncore.com/use-cases/consulting-firms/): Scope of work (SOW) proposals, multi-stakeholder billing, and executive client portals.
- [Freelancers](https://eidoncore.com/use-cases/freelancers/): All-in-one business management replacing 5 separate apps with professional client-facing branding.

## Plans & Pricing

- **Starter Plan** ($29/month, or $24/month billed annually): Up to 5 team members, 15 active projects, custom agency branding, invoicing, and task boards.
- **Pro Plan** ($79/month, or $64/month billed annually): Up to 25 team members, unlimited projects, custom CNAME domain, full AI Workspace, and priority support.
- **Agency Plan** ($199/month, or $159/month billed annually): Unlimited team members, enterprise SLA, custom webhook integrations, and dedicated account manager.
- **Trial**: 14-day fully featured free Pro trial with zero credit card required.
- More details: [Eidoncore Pricing](https://eidoncore.com/pricing/)

## Competitor Comparisons

- [Eidoncore vs AgencyHandy](https://eidoncore.com/compare/agencyhandy/): Eidoncore includes a native AI Workspace (111+ tools), digital e-signature proposals, and transparent flat pricing without per-seat penalties.
- [Eidoncore vs Bonsai](https://eidoncore.com/compare/bonsai/): Bonsai focuses on solo freelancers; Eidoncore is engineered for scaling multi-member agencies with team permissions, budget burndowns, and MCP agent orchestration.
- [Eidoncore vs HoneyBook](https://eidoncore.com/compare/honeybook/): HoneyBook targets event planners and solo creative businesses; Eidoncore provides deep white-label CNAME portals, sprint boards, and developer-grade AI tools.
- [Eidoncore vs Kitchen.co](https://eidoncore.com/compare/kitchen/): Eidoncore delivers complete end-to-end agency operations including milestone budgets, automated intake forms, and AI copilots.
- [Eidoncore vs Moxie](https://eidoncore.com/compare/moxie/): Eidoncore offers native model context protocol agent tools, unlimited client portals, and superior scalability for scaling teams.
